title: Pair up neighbours
statementMd:
Group elements into consecutive pairs `[[a0, a1], [a2, a3], ...]`; a final unpaired element forms a single-element list.

**Example:** `pair_up([1, 2, 3, 4])` returns `[[1, 2], [3, 4]]`.
solutionMd:
```python
def pair_up(items):
    return [items[i:i + 2] for i in range(0, len(items), 2)]
```

A special case of chunking.
